sources.title: BAGEL: The Open-Source Unified Multimodal Model
sources.snippet: Today we introduce BAGEL, the open-source Unified Multimodal Model you can fine-tune, distill and deploy anywhere, offering comparable functionality to proprietary systems like GPT-4o and Gemini 2.0 in an open form, unlocks useful and valuable image generation through a natively multimodal architecture capable of precise, accurate, and photorealistic outputs.
